study: Official FlashSAC cable retry: bundled n3 and full-budget LR
scope: One exploratory seed2 retry and one separately audited historical same-seed reference; no pooled population or causal factor isolation.
sampling: Every audited training iteration and scored checkpoint; no smoothing or synthetic missing values.

figures.name: evaluation-transitions
figures.caption: Nine actual saved checkpoints per run on the same 128 complete initial states. Ever-goal, full-budget occupancy, final 15-step hold and lift are distinct. The final-distance panel includes zero and the 5 cm per-state goal-tolerance reference; that reference is not a population-mean success gate. No contact/grasp condition or confidence interval is inferred. Write-finished time is policy availability, not durability; historical and retry process/cache histories differ.

figures.name: evaluation-wall
figures.caption: Nine actual saved checkpoints per run on the same 128 complete initial states. Ever-goal, full-budget occupancy, final 15-step hold and lift are distinct. The final-distance panel includes zero and the 5 cm per-state goal-tolerance reference; that reference is not a population-mean success gate. figures.name: stochastic-collection
figures.caption: All 2000 exact per-iteration aggregates, including uniform warmup and autoresets; no smoothing. Historical cable-state fields are unavailable and are not filled with zeros. World-ever is not episode success. Middle height includes zero and the 5 cm lift threshold. Finger positions reconstruct relative joint observations plus defaults; their sum is shown on a 0–8 cm axis, not as a measured fingertip gap or contact geometry. The last panel shows the mean command and the positive-command fraction in [0,1]; per-step height gain is available separately in summary.json. These proxies do not prove grasp.

figures.name: optimization-diagnostics
figures.caption: Keys can come from different update calls; these are not iteration means. Alpha weights entropy loss rather than multiplying rollout noise; negative differential entropy is valid. The Gaussian-reference target is not a measured action standard deviation. Critic loss and max_entropy_bonus do not prove support saturation or a causal failure mechanism.

figures.name: action-reward-diagnostics
figures.caption: Every exact iteration is retained. Dimensions0–6 command arm joints and7 the gripper before the unchanged gain1 task boundary. RMS is not stochastic standard deviation or actuator saturation. Weighted reward contributions include control_dt and precede SAC normalization; shaping rewards alone do not establish physical lift or goal attainment.

figures.name: execution-costs
figures.caption: Two individually observed run protocols; no average or speed ratio. Whole training includes imports/environment, learning/collection, metrics and all checkpoint writes including the final full replay export. Startup/components overlap with whole scopes and must not be summed. Device/order/cache history, instrumentation and learned trajectories differ; these clocks do not isolate learning kernels or faster successful learning.
